title: Refine lookup code generation

baseline.native_result: 196 bytes; 25/42 direct words; 3/3 call relocation shapes; four table HI16/LO16 relocation-layout differences; first mismatch +0x28

new_variants.single_change: Add register storage-class hint to volatile s32 half.
new_variants.decision: No improvement; register hint did not change the measured native mismatch profile.

new_variants.single_change: Move the volatile half-index declaration after out and entry locals.
new_variants.decision: No improvement; declaration order did not change the measured native mismatch profile.

new_variants.single_change: Use s16 for the table entry local, matching the observed signed-halfword load source.
new_variants.decision: No improvement; signed table-entry narrowing did not change the measured native mismatch profile.

validation.comparison_method: Native IDO relocatable objects compared against ROM-validated Splat rows; no GNU-reassembled IDO listing used.
validation.official_proof: decomp/results/combined.json remains 148 exact claims / 11020 bytes / full ROM SHA-1 6ea0ed71032ce08fc2745f412d84936382197494

limitations: All three new variants retain the same relocation, register and stack mismatch profile.
The probes are local and ignored; they are not linked at original VMA or production-integrated.
An initial local host invocation used a source path relative to the repository root; after correcting it to be relative to decomp/, all three 3000-case runs passed.
